config.csv_convention: x0 = X - 0.5, y0 = Y - 0.5, x1 = x0 + Length, y1 = y0 + Height

csv_generation_rule.hypothesis: CSV = strict-blue components of ground mask with width and height >= 21 px (plus manual/other edits)

apparent_size_overlap.note: green = physically small/medium rocks; many appear as large in the image as CSV 'large' rocks
green = physically small/medium rocks; many appear as large in the image as CSV 'large' rocks

hybrid_policy_H_candidate_subset.definition: CSV boxes + blue comps 50..999px not >=50% inside a CSV box (proxy ok) + green comps >= 50px (proxy ok); variant V1_cyan

auto_class_definitions.box_covers_mask_pixels_other: joint bbox of blue/cyan pixels in the box covers >=50% of it with >=20% fill, none of the above
auto_class_definitions.fragmented_mask_components: >=2 strict-blue components (>=25px) lie >=80% inside the box and their joint bbox covers >=50% of it
auto_class_definitions.mask_component_extends_beyond_box: a strict-blue component bbox contains >=90% of the box and is >=1.5x larger (box covers part of a larger/merged mask region)
auto_class_definitions.matched_after_cyan_assignment: matched at IoU>=0.5 once cyan edge pixels count as large rock (V1_cyan)
auto_class_definitions.no_large_rock_pixels_in_box: <2% of box pixels are blue/cyan in the ground mask
auto_class_definitions.note: automated mechanism triage only; whether the box is a correct label is decided by visual review

V0_strict.description: pure blue / pure green pixels, no morphology (Task A rule)

V1_cyan.description: cyan edge pixels assigned to large rock, no morphology

V2_cyan_close3.description: V1 + 3x3 closing per class before labelling

policy.excluded: brackets without a labelled 512-2048 ms image (NoSun light-off sets are all dark)
policy.rule: for each (terrain, position, light, sun, camera) bracket with a detection label, take the 512/1024/2048 ms image with the largest fraction of pixels in 600..3800 (Task A well_exposed_frac); ties -> shorter exposure

visualisation.auto_visibility_rule: visible_fixed_linear: p95-p5 inside box >= 12 grey levels in fixed view; visible_only_enhanced: same in enhanced view AND raw p95-p5 >= 6 x sigma_noise (sigma from MAD of horizontal pixel differences); else not_identifiable. This is a contrast proxy; a box with texture but no rock would also pass.

candidates.definition: pass = VISIBLE_ROCK (a distinct rock visible in the render at native resolution, box tight within ~2px). Denominator = reviewed candidates in the stratum. Strata are NOT proportional to population; do not average them.

sampled_review.reviewer: AI assistant visual assessment (NOT human validation)
